mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification_request (request_id, tenant_id, source_system, source_event_key, notification_template_id, default_locale, default_parameters, notification_route_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{tenantId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceEventKey}, #{notificationTemplateId}, #{defaultLocale}, #{defaultParameters}, #{notificationRouteId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.tenant_id, r.source_system, r.source_event_key, r.notification_template_id, r.default_locale, r.default_parameters, r.notification_route_id, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM t_notification_request r ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.request_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
